Significant Efficacy in Migraine Prevention

Subject: Efficacy and Safety of Zefranova
From: ZOFLEVRIX Team

Dear Healthcare Professional,

Zefranova 60 mg once daily has demonstrated significant efficacy in reducing monthly migraine days. In a simulated randomized controlled trial, Zefranova reduced monthly migraine days by an average of 5.9 days compared to a 3.4-day reduction with placebo, resulting in a simulated between-group difference of 2.5 days.

Additionally, Zefranova reduced monthly headache days by an average of 6.8 days, while placebo resulted in a 4.1-day reduction, yielding a difference of 2.7 days. The treatment also led to a ≥50% migraine-day responder rate of 44.2%, compared to 27.7% for placebo, indicating a substantial improvement in patient outcomes.

Key message: Zefranova offers a favorable safety profile with most adverse events being mild or moderate.

Safety and Tolerability Highlights

Adverse Events: 57.8% of patients experienced any treatment-emergent adverse event.
Mild Adverse Events: 36.9% reported mild adverse events.
Moderate Adverse Events: 18.9% reported moderate adverse events.
Serious Adverse Events: Only 1.5% experienced serious adverse events.

Disclaimer: As a healthcare professional, you should monitor for treatment-emergent adverse events such as nausea, fatigue, and dizziness. Patients should be counseled to seek medical attention if symptoms of hypersensitivity occur.

Important safety guideline: Most common adverse events included nausea (11.7%), fatigue (10.7%), and dizziness (7.3%).
